ns2:course.label: Senior Research Project
ns2:course.description: Individual research project under the guidance of a faculty member; for example, mathematical analysis, laboratory experiments, computer simulations, software development, circuit design, or device fabrication. Preparation of a written research proposal, including preliminary results. No graduate credit. ECE 497 and ECE 499 taken in sequence fulfill the Advanced Composition Requirement. May be repeated. Prerequisite: RHET 105; consent of instructor.
